tldrPoints: Choose a safe, stable position before kickoff and check venue permission.
Use landscape orientation and record a short test clip before the match starts.
Higher resolution or frame rate can improve detail, but it also uses more battery and storage.
A secure fence mount, post mount or tripod is safer than holding the phone by hand.
Pitchside is in private beta and is testing supported stats and highlights from suitable footage.
merge.aeoQuickAnswer: To record a football match on your phone, use a safe landscape setup with a stable mount, check that the important playing area is visible and record a short test clip before kickoff. Settings depend on your device, storage and battery.

ctaBlock.headline: Turn your match footage into highlights
ctaBlock.description: Record the match safely, then use suitable footage with Pitchside as the private beta expands supported stats and highlights.
